topic: Reading a burned scroll without physically opening it
centralQuestion: How can writing be read inside a scroll too fragile to open?
thesis: A detectable ink signal and traced internal surfaces can be mapped into readable digital images while leaving the fragile original rolled up.
viewerPayoff: Understand the distinction between physically opening a page and computationally locating, texturing and flattening its surviving surface.
